meta.title: WoW Forever Hunter spell ranks, every level 1-60

status_legend.forever: Forever client data (build 1.60.1.70862) as carried by wowsims-forever

source.records: sim/core/spelldata/spells_auto_gen.go (wowsims's generator bakes in tools/database/overrides; any override comment is copied to the rank's wowsims_overrides: those fields are wowsims's in-game measurements, not client rows)
source.vanilla: cmangos classic-db spell_template (1.12) for vanilla_* fields, npc_trainer_template 31 + npc_trainer rows of class 3 trainers for vanilla_trainer (teach spell -> learned spell through effect 36 LEARN_SPELL)

formulas.value_at_level: BasePoints + PPL * clamp(min(L, scaling_max_level) - scaling_base_level, 0); scaling_max_level 0 = no cap. Computed in float32 as wowsims Effect.AverageAt. Damage/heal amounts keep the fraction; every other amount is floored.
formulas.cost: cost.mana flat; cost.pct_base_mana = pct of base mana (base_mana table in <class>_levels.json); cost.rage in rage (row value / 10); cost.energy; cost.combo_points_min = the finisher needs at least that many; cost.health (Life Tap row has none: wowsims spends amount + Spirit).
formulas.learn_level: SpellLevels.SpellLevel of the rank (client). learned_from.vanilla_trainer gives the vanilla 1.12 trainer level and cost for comparison. 2 Nov notes: training every class ability 1-60 costs 206-207 gold in Forever, so vanilla costs are not Forever costs.
formulas.vanilla_compare: vanilla.changes_vs_vanilla compares learn level, flat cost, cooldowns and each effect's amount at the learn level (vanilla BasePoints+1 .. BasePoints+DieSides, Forever tooltip range) with the 1.12 row of the same id. A difference of 1 point or less is ignored. Cast times and durations are not compared (the 1.12 rows store index ids into tables not in the local data).
formulas.required_stance_mask: client StanceMask bit field (1 << (form id - 1)); e.g. warrior Battle 17, Defensive 18, Berserker 19; druid Cat 1, Bear 5, Dire Bear 8, Moonkin 31.

coefficient_penalties.finding: Neither wowsims-forever nor mythicsim-forever-engine applies the vanilla sub-20 penalty (1 - (20 - spellLevel)*0.0375) or a downrank coefficient penalty. Ranks learned below 20 carry sp_coef_if_vanilla_sub20_penalty so a sim can switch the vanilla rule on.
coefficient_penalties.forever_notes: kami-labs summary of the 2 Nov 2026 notes: the low-rank penalty was removed from several chance-based talents and stays on Arcane Concentration, Frostbite and Fingers of Frost (proc less often when the rank was learned more than 12 levels below the caster). Nothing in the notes speaks to damage/heal coefficients of low ranks.

forever_class_notes: Aimed Shot baseline at 20; Arcane Shot and Aimed Shot cooldowns split, Multi-Shot shares Aimed Shot's; traps usable in combat, shared 30 s cooldown; Aspect of the Beast grants melee AP; Scorpid Sting -2% hit (Blizzard Hunter & Druid deep dive).
2 Nov notes: Aimed Shot +110% bonus damage, Arcane Shot +30% and AP coefficient 0.15, Serpent Sting +20% and 5% AP per tick, Aspect of the Hawk 20/35/50/70/90/110 RAP, Trueshot Aura 20/35/50/75/100.
notes_sources: Warcraft Tavern summaries of Blizzard's Forever class deep dives: Priest & Warrior (1 Oct 2026, Blizzard news 24301514), Mage & Shaman (7 Oct, 24302097), Rogue & Warlock (7 Oct, 24310968); 'All Changes to Paladins' (21 Sep 2026); 'WoW Forever Pre-Launch Class Changes & Bug Fixes' (4 Nov 2026, from Kaivax's Beta Development Notes updated 2 Nov).
Blizzard news 'World of Warcraft: Forever Class Deep Dives - Hunter and Druid' (news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24301515).
kami-labs 'WoW Forever November 2 patch: 223 changes before launch' (datamined items marked).
The Blizzard forum dev-notes thread itself could not be fetched here (needs approval); its content is taken from the summaries above.
Where a note and a client row disagree, the row wins; the row values are the ones in ranks[].

wowsims_code_notes.comment: [if sim.GetRemainingDurationPercent() < 1.0-hp.uptimePercent {] once fight is % completed, disable pet. || The Faster Attack and Slower Attack passives a tamed creature carries on top of the 2 s swing, by the option that names them. A tamed pet's own armor and health are the creature values for its level in the game files (core.CreatureArmorMaxLevel, core.CreatureHealthMaxLevel), and its own attack power is 30% of the creature dps (core.CreatureAutoAttackDpsMaxLevel) as attack power, 14 a point of dps, with nothing from Strength: 36, 61 and 103 on the sheets of a level 11 Carrion Bird, a level 17 Cat and a level 30 pet, each the creature dps × 4.2 rounded down, with the owner's 10% rounded down beside it. TODO: Health is one reading, 550 with Great Stamina 2 at 35 owner Stamina, which the creature health fits with ~1.1 health a point of the owner's Stamina, and half of it with the warlock's 7.5. The creature health is kept until a second reading at another Stamina. The creature dps is the pet's auto attack damage with its own attack power in it, so the swing before attack power is the creature dps less that attack power over 14, over the 2.0 s, spanning 20% either side: a level 30 Cat's logged swings before armor, 42-55 and 46-59 at 119 and 146 attack power, swinging at 1.2 s with Unleashed Fury 5/5, are this swing plus attack power over 14, over the swing as sped up, with the Cat's +10% and happiness. The pet sheet shows the whole creature dps as the weapon and leaves happiness out, so its damage range is not the damage the pet deals. What the pet casts in melee range, longest cooldown first, and what it casts to close the distance when it is not. Bestial Discipline's effect 1 raises every effect of the pet's focus passive: +10% a rank. Normalized in ApplyTalents to the Faster or Slower Attack passive's swing. Happiness Hunter Pet Scaling (415429) states every inherited stat without an amount, the server pricing them: 2 health a point of stamina, 30% of armor, 10% of the higher attack power, the owner's higher crit (inheritedCrit), the owner's ranged hit, 17/8 of it as spell hit, and the owner's expertise, the armor, attack power and crit read on a level 17 pet

notes: Traps usable in combat; all traps share one 30 s cooldown (2 Nov notes).

wowsims_code_notes.comment: TODO: In-game testing required. The rows state no attack power share; the Forever notes give the damage traps 10% of ranged attack power over their whole duration, split evenly over the ticks and read at each tick. Explosive Trap's initial hit takes the same 10% on top. TODO: In-game testing required. The game files carry no trap object, so its trigger radius and arming delay are not in the store. Forever lets traps be placed in combat; a trap lies where the hunter stood and springs on a target within this radius once armed. The placement spell: shared trap cooldown, mana and GCD from its row. The trap lies at the hunter's distance from the target when placed, so moving away afterwards does not stop it; a trap placed out of reach of the standing target never springs. A trap placed mid-walk lies where the hunter is now, not where the walk started. Effect 2 is a persistent area aura the resolvers do not read, so its dot is built here.

wowsims_code_notes.comment: The APL queues it through the tag 1 spell below; the next swing casts it. Raptor Strike goes off on the next main-hand swing, as Heroic Strike does: the APL casts the tag 1 spell, which queues it, and the next swing casts it in the swing's place. Queuing has no range: it can be set walking in, so the first swing on arrival takes it. The swing a main-hand auto becomes: the queued Raptor Strike when it can still be cast, the plain swing otherwise. A swing that cannot cast it drops the queue.

SerpentSting.name: Serpent Sting
notes: 2 Nov notes: AP per tick 3% -> 5%, base about +20%. Rank 9 (25295) is a book rank.

wowsims_code_notes.comment: Rank 8 is the last rank the trainer teaches; rank 9 comes from the Guide: Serpent Sting IX book. TODO: In-game testing required. The row states no attack power share on the tick; the Forever notes give each tick 5% of ranged attack power, read at each tick. Spell power adds nothing. A ranged ability, as the game files' ranged-ability procs (Rapid Recuperation) see it, so the ticks crit at the ranged crit. The application deals no damage, so the on-hit listeners that require damage skip it, and the ticks reach only periodic listeners.

notes: Marksmanship talent (16 points, new). Summons a Hawk for 18 s, up to 2; shares Arcane Shot's cooldown (deep dive).

wowsims_code_notes.comment: The creature the dive leaves behind, up for 18 s. The tooltip's ${$s1+($rap*($s4/100))}: effect 4 is the share of ranged attack power. A hawk the dive leaves behind: a guardian with a pet's base stats and swing damage, summoned at the enemy by the cast. A hawk only swings: its rotation sleeps for as long as a hawk can be up. What a hawk is, read off level 30 combat logs of 2862 swings at 407 to 1023 owner ranged attack power: 5% of the creature health for its level and no armor or attack power of its own; 80% of the owner's ranged attack power and 30% of the owner's armor on top. The row that scales a hawk, Hunter Guardian Hawk Pet Scaling 01 (1293586), is not in the store, so the swing below is fitted to those logs. A swing before armor read 0.0815 of the creature dps over the 2.5 s, spanning a third either side, plus 0.0179 a point of the owner's ranged attack power: 112 attack power a point of dps at 80% of it. Both are fitted (3.3-6.7 plus 0.0179 × ranged attack power at level 30), not stated in the game files, and were read with Unleashed Fury 5/5, which reaches the hawks, so the swing here is before it. Effect 3 is the number of hawks up at once. A hawk's swing follows its owner's ranged speed while it is up, a quiver's and Quick Shots' included; Berserking's attack speed does not reach it in game. Its crit is half the tamed pet's, the higher of melee and ranged (inheritedCrit), with none from Agility: 4340 swings with Ferocity 5/5 read 10 plus half the owner's crit against targets 2 levels below to 3 above it, and 0-Ferocity logs half the tamed pet's. Its melee hit and expertise are the tamed pet's: 1% hit took a hawk from 1 miss in 32 swings to none in 515 against a target 8 levels below it. The damage done is the owner's as the hawk is summoned, on top of the hawk's own. The tamed pet and the hawks: what the talents that name pets and hawks reach. The dive's damage, then a hawk for 18 s. The hawks take turns, so one past the count replaces the one with the least time left.
